items.stem: Distinguish between current account and savings account on the basis of interest, number of withdrawals, overdraft and purpose.
items.answer: (i) Interest: current account: generally no interest is paid; savings account: interest is paid on the balance. (iii) Overdraft: current account: overdraft facility is available; savings account: overdraft is not usually available. (iv) Purpose: current account: for businesses with frequent transactions; savings account: for individuals to save money.

items.answer: (i) Overdraft on current account; cash credit against stock (also discounting of bills, short-term loan). (ii) Bank draft; electronic fund transfer (NEFT/RTGS) or internet banking.

items.stem: Distinguish between life insurance and fire insurance on the basis of insurable interest, period and investment element.
items.answer: (i) Insurable interest: life insurance: must exist at the time of the contract; fire insurance: must exist at the time of contract and at the time of loss. (ii) Period: life insurance: usually for a long period; fire insurance: usually for one year. (iii) Investment element: life insurance: has an element of saving or investment; fire insurance: no investment element.
items.markingKey: 1 mark for each basis: (i) Insurable interest: life insurance: must exist at the time of the contract; fire insurance: must exist at the time of contract and at the time of loss. (ii) Period: life insurance: usually for a long period; fire insurance: usually for one year. (iii) Investment element: life insurance: has an element of saving or investment; fire insurance: no investment element.

items.stem: Goyal Traders has hundreds of payments and receipts every day. Which type of deposit account suits the need?
items.answer: Current account
items.markingKey: (b) Current account. Current accounts allow unlimited transactions and overdraft.

items.stem: Explain the following types of telecom services: (i) DTH services (ii) Cellular mobile services.
items.answer: (i) DTH services: Television directly to homes via satellite dish. (ii) Cellular mobile services: Mobile voice and data services.
items.markingKey: 2 marks each: (i) Television directly to homes via satellite dish. (ii) Mobile voice and data services.

items.stem: What is meant by "Utmost good faith"?
items.answer: Both parties must disclose all material facts fully and honestly (uberrimae fidei).
items.markingKey: 1 mark: Both parties must disclose all material facts fully and honestly (uberrimae fidei).

items.stem: Gauri sends a legal notice and wants proof that it was delivered. Which postal service is used? Justify your answer.
items.answer: Registered post. Registration gives proof of posting and delivery.
items.markingKey: 1 mark for identifying Registered post; 2 marks for the justification: Registration gives proof of posting and delivery.

items.stem:
Kabir runs a hotel in Delhi. Guests complain that service differs between staff and that rooms left empty on weekdays are a loss.
(i) Name the features of services shown by the two complaints. (ii) Suggest one step for each. (iii) Why is a hotel stay intangible?
items.answer: (i) Inconsistency (service varies) and inventory (less): empty rooms cannot be stored. (ii) Train staff and set service standards; offer weekday discounts or packages to fill capacity. (iii) It cannot be touched or tested before use; the guest only experiences it.
items.markingKey: 6 marks: (i) Inconsistency (service varies) and inventory (less): empty rooms cannot be stored. (ii) Train staff and set service standards; offer weekday discounts or packages to fill capacity. (iii) It cannot be touched or tested before use; the guest only experiences it.

items.stem: Which of the following is true of life insurance but not of fire insurance?
items.answer: Amount payable: the sum assured on death or maturity
items.markingKey: (d) life insurance: Amount payable: the sum assured on death or maturity. The other options describe fire insurance.
options: Amount payable: actual loss up to the sum insured
Amount payable: the sum assured on death or maturity

items.stem: Yash buys a phone on a card and pays the bank later, within the credit period. Which e-banking facility is used? Justify your answer.
items.answer: Credit card. A credit card lets the holder buy now and pay later.
items.markingKey: 1 mark for identifying Credit card; 2 marks for the justification: A credit card lets the holder buy now and pay later.

items.stem: Which of the following best describes "RTGS"?
items.answer: An electronic system that transfers funds individually and immediately (real-time gross settlement), used mainly for large amounts.
items.markingKey: (a) RTGS: An electronic system that transfers funds individually and immediately (real-time gross settlement), used mainly for large amounts.

items.stem: Farmers who are members of a marketing society store their produce in the society's godown at low rates. Which type of warehouse is described? Justify your answer.
items.answer: Cooperative warehouse. Run by cooperative societies for members.
items.markingKey: 1 mark for identifying Cooperative warehouse; 2 marks for the justification: Run by cooperative societies for members.

items.stem:
Dev insured his sports goods shop in Coimbatore for ₹20 lakh with two insurers, ₹10 lakh each. A fire caused a loss of ₹6 lakh.
(i) How much will Dev receive in total, and on what principle? (ii) How will the two insurers share it?
items.answer: (i) ₹6 lakh in total, by the principle of indemnity (actual loss only). (ii) By contribution in proportion to their policies: ₹3 lakh each.
items.markingKey: 4 marks: (i) ₹6 lakh in total, by the principle of indemnity (actual loss only). (ii) By contribution in proportion to their policies: ₹3 lakh each.
